text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In the event of overdose, serious adverse reactions may result [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 , 5.7 )] . Stop the infusion of PERIKABIVEN to allow lipids to clear from serum. The effects are usually reversible after the lipid infusion is stopped. If medically appropriate, further intervention may be indicated. The lipid administered and fatty acids produced are not dialyzable.
